const asRecord = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null => {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const candidate = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return Object.keys(candidate).some((key) => DANGEROUS_KEYS.has(key)) ? null : candidate;
};

const stableJson = (value: unknown): string => {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(stableJson).join(",")}]`;
  const candidate = asRecord(value);
  if (candidate !== null) {
    return `{${Object.keys(candidate)
      .sort()
      .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${stableJson(candidate[key])}`)
      .join(",")}}`;
  }
  if (typeof value === "number" && !Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error("workflow contract contains non-finite number");
  return JSON.stringify(value);
};

const ownedFrozen = (value: unknown): unknown => {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (value.length > MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS) throw new Error("workflow collection exceeds bound");
    return Object.freeze(value.map(ownedFrozen));
  }
  const candidate = asRecord(value);
  if (candidate !== null) {
    if (Object.keys(candidate).length > MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS) throw new Error("workflow object exceeds bound");
    return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(candidate).map(([key, item]) => [key, ownedFrozen(item)])));
  }
  if (typeof value === "number" && !Number.isFinite(value)) throw new Error("workflow contract contains non-finite number");
  return value;
};

const schemaRecord = (value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> => {
  const candidate = asRecord(value);
  if (candidate === null) throw new Error("generated workflow schema is malformed");
  return candidate;
};

const resolveReference = (reference: unknown): Record<string, unknown> => {
  const prefix = "#/$defs/";
  if (typeof reference !== "string" || !reference.startsWith(prefix)) throw new Error("unsupported workflow schema reference");
  return schemaRecord(schemaRecord(WORKFLOW_SCHEMA.$defs)[reference.slice(prefix.length)]);
};

const typeMatches = (value: unknown, kind: unknown): boolean => {
  if (kind === "null") return value === null;
  if (kind === "boolean") return typeof value === "boolean";
  if (kind === "integer") return typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value);
  if (kind === "number") return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value);
  if (kind === "string") return typeof value === "string";
  if (kind === "array") return Array.isArray(value);
  if (kind === "object") return asRecord(value) !== null;
  return false;
};

const validationErrors = (value: unknown, node: Record<string, unknown>, path: string): string[] => {
  if ("$ref" in node) return validationErrors(value, resolveReference(node.$ref), path);
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if ("const" in node && (value !== node.const || typeof value !== typeof node.const)) errors.push(`${path}: const`);
  if (Array.isArray(node.enum) && !node.enum.some((item) => value === item && typeof value === typeof item)) errors.push(`${path}: enum`);
  if (Array.isArray(node.oneOf)) {
    const matches = node.oneOf.filter((item) => validationErrors(value, schemaRecord(item), path).length === 0).length;
    if (matches !== 1) errors.push(`${path}: alternatives`);
  }
  const types = Array.isArray(node.type) ? node.type : node.type === undefined ? [] : [node.type];
  if (types.length > 0 && !types.some((kind) => typeMatches(value, kind))) return [...errors, `${path}: type`];
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    if (typeof node.minimum === "number" && value < node.minimum) errors.push(`${path}: minimum`);
    if (typeof node.maximum === "number" && value > node.maximum) errors.push(`${path}: maximum`);
  }
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    if (typeof node.minLength === "number" && value.length < node.minLength) errors.push(`${path}: minLength`);
    if (typeof node.maxLength === "number" && value.length > node.maxLength) errors.push(`${path}: maxLength`);
    if (typeof node.pattern === "string" && !new RegExp(node.pattern, "u").test(value)) errors.push(`${path}: pattern`);
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (typeof node.minItems === "number" && value.length < node.minItems) errors.push(`${path}: minItems`);
    if (typeof node.maxItems === "number" && value.length > node.maxItems) return [...errors, `${path}: maxItems`];
    if (node.uniqueItems === true && new Set(value.map(stableJson)).size !== value.length) errors.push(`${path}: uniqueItems`);
    const items = asRecord(node.items);
    if (items !== null) value.forEach((item, index) => errors.push(...validationErrors(item, items, `${path}/${index}`)));
  }
  const candidate = asRecord(value);
  if (candidate !== null && (types.includes("object") || asRecord(node.properties) !== null)) {
    if (Array.isArray(node.required)) {
      for (const key of node.required) if (typeof key === "string" && !(key in candidate)) errors.push(`${path}/${key}: required`);
    }
    const properties = schemaRecord(node.properties ?? {});
    if (node.additionalProperties === false) {
      for (const key of Object.keys(candidate)) if (!(key in properties)) errors.push(`${path}/${key}: additional property`);
    }
    for (const [key, property] of Object.entries(properties)) {
      if (key in candidate) errors.push(...validationErrors(candidate[key], schemaRecord(property), `${path}/${key}`));
    }
  }
  return errors;
};

const schemaDefinition = (name: string): Record<string, unknown> => schemaRecord(schemaRecord(WORKFLOW_SCHEMA.$defs)[name]);

const progressInvalid = (progress: Record<string, unknown>): boolean => {
  if (progress.kind === "quantified") {
    return !Number.isSafeInteger(progress.completedUnits) || !Number.isSafeInteger(progress.totalUnits) || (progress.completedUnits as number) > (progress.totalUnits as number);
  }
  return progress.completedUnits !== null || progress.totalUnits !== null;
};

const sha256Hex = (text: string): string => {
  const constants = [
    0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2,
  ];
  const input = new TextEncoder().encode(text);
  const length = Math.ceil((input.length + 9) / 64) * 64;
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(length);
  bytes.set(input);
  bytes[input.length] = 0x80;
  let bits = BigInt(input.length) * 8n;
  for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) {
    bytes[length - 1 - index] = Number(bits & 0xffn);
    bits >>= 8n;
  }
  const hash = new Uint32Array([0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19]);
  const words = new Uint32Array(64);
  const rotate = (value: number, count: number): number => (value >>> count) | (value << (32 - count));
  for (let offset = 0; offset < length; offset += 64) {
    for (let index = 0; index < 16; index += 1) {
      const base = offset + index * 4;
      words[index] = (((bytes[base] ?? 0) << 24) | ((bytes[base + 1] ?? 0) << 16) | ((bytes[base + 2] ?? 0) << 8) | (bytes[base + 3] ?? 0)) >>> 0;
    }
    for (let index = 16; index < 64; index += 1) {
      const a = words[index - 15] ?? 0;
      const b = words[index - 2] ?? 0;
      const s0 = rotate(a, 7) ^ rotate(a, 18) ^ (a >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotate(b, 17) ^ rotate(b, 19) ^ (b >>> 10);
      words[index] = ((words[index - 16] ?? 0) + s0 + (words[index - 7] ?? 0) + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h] = Array.from(hash) as [number,number,number,number,number,number,number,number];
    for (let index = 0; index < 64; index += 1) {
      const s1 = rotate(e, 6) ^ rotate(e, 11) ^ rotate(e, 25);
      const choice = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const temp1 = (h + s1 + choice + (constants[index] ?? 0) + (words[index] ?? 0)) >>> 0;
      const s0 = rotate(a, 2) ^ rotate(a, 13) ^ rotate(a, 22);
      const majority = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const temp2 = (s0 + majority) >>> 0;
      h=g; g=f; f=e; e=(d+temp1)>>>0; d=c; c=b; b=a; a=(temp1+temp2)>>>0;
    }
    for (const [index, value] of [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h].entries()) hash[index] = ((hash[index] ?? 0) + value) >>> 0;
  }
  return Array.from(hash).map((value) => value.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).join("");
};

export const canonicalWorkflowJson = (value: unknown): string => {
  const candidate = asRecord(value);
  if (candidate === null || ![
    "research-observatory-workflow-definition",
    "research-observatory-workflow-snapshot",
    "research-observatory-legacy-operation-bridge",
  ].includes(candidate.documentType as string)) throw new Error("invalid workflow contract document");
  return stableJson(value);
};

export const workflowRecordSha256 = (value: unknown): string => `sha256:${sha256Hex(canonicalWorkflowJson(value))}`;

export const workflowDefinitionErrors = (value: unknown): readonly string[] => {
  const structural = validationErrors(value, schemaDefinition("WorkflowDefinition"), "$");
  if (structural.length > 0) return structural;
  const definition = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const steps = definition.steps as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const keys = steps.map((step) => step.stepKey as string);
  if (new Set(keys).size !== keys.length) errors.push("definition-step-keys-are-unique");
  const stepMap = new Map(steps.map((step) => [step.stepKey as string, step]));
  const visiting = new Set<string>();
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (key: string): boolean => {
    if (visiting.has(key)) return false;
    if (visited.has(key)) return true;
    const step = stepMap.get(key);
    if (step === undefined) return false;
    visiting.add(key);
    if (!(step.dependsOn as string[]).every(visit)) return false;
    visiting.delete(key); visited.add(key); return true;
  };
  if (stepMap.size !== steps.length || !keys.every(visit)) errors.push("definition-dependencies-close-and-are-acyclic");
  for (const step of steps) {
    const activity = step.kind === "activity";
    if (activity !== (typeof step.activityType === "string") || activity === (step.humanTask !== null)) errors.push("step-shape-matches-kind");
    const retry = step.retryPolicy as Record<string, unknown>;
    if ((retry.maximumBackoffMs as number) < (retry.initialBackoffMs as number) || (retry.retryableErrorCodes as string[]).some((code) => (retry.nonRetryableErrorCodes as string[]).includes(code))) errors.push("retry-policy-is-consistent");
    const idempotency = step.idempotency as Record<string, unknown>;
    if ((idempotency.mode === "required") !== (typeof idempotency.keyScope === "string")) errors.push("idempotency-policy-is-consistent");
    const checkpoint = step.checkpointPolicy as Record<string, unknown>;
    if ((checkpoint.mode === "forbidden") !== (checkpoint.maximumIntervalSeconds === null)) errors.push("checkpoint-policy-is-consistent");
    const progress = step.progress as Record<string, unknown>;
    if ((progress.totalKind === "known") !== Number.isSafeInteger(progress.totalUnits)) errors.push("progress-shape-is-consistent");
  }
  return [...new Set(errors)];
};

export const decodeWorkflowDefinition = (value: unknown): WorkflowDefinition | null => {
  let owned: unknown;
  try { owned = ownedFrozen(value); } catch { return null; }
  return workflowDefinitionErrors(owned).length === 0 ? (owned as WorkflowDefinition) : null;
};

export const workflowTransitionAllowed = (entityType: string, fromState: string | null, toState: string): boolean => {
  const entity = TRANSITIONS[entityType as WorkflowEntityType];
  return entity !== undefined && (entity[fromState ?? "<initial>"] ?? []).includes(toState);
};

const collectionMap = (snapshot: Record<string, unknown>, collection: string, identity: string): Map<string, Record<string, unknown>> =>
  new Map((snapshot[collection] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).map((item) => [item[identity] as string, item]));

const reconstruct = (snapshot: Record<string, unknown>): { state: Record<WorkflowEntityType, Record<string, string>>; latest: Map<string, number>; errors: string[] } => {
  const state: Record<WorkflowEntityType, Record<string, string>> = {"workflow-run": {}, "workflow-step": {}, job: {}, "job-attempt": {}, "human-task": {}};
  const latest = new Map<string, number>();
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const progress = new Map<string, [string, number | null, number | null]>();
  let securityLocked = false;
  (snapshot.history as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).forEach((event, index) => {
    if (event.sequence !== index + 1) errors.push("history-sequence-is-contiguous");
    const kind = event.entityType as WorkflowEntityType;
    const id = event.entityId as string;
    const prior = state[kind][id] ?? null;
    if (event.fromState !== prior || !workflowTransitionAllowed(kind, prior, event.toState as string)) errors.push("history-transition-is-allowed");
    else state[kind][id] = event.toState as string;
    latest.set(`${kind}:${id}`, event.sequence as number);
    const itemProgress = asRecord(event.progress);
    if (kind === "job-attempt" && itemProgress !== null) {
      if (progressInvalid(itemProgress)) errors.push("progress-shape-is-consistent");
      const current: [string, number | null, number | null] = [itemProgress.kind as string, itemProgress.completedUnits as number | null, itemProgress.totalUnits as number | null];
      const previous = progress.get(id);
      if (previous !== undefined && (previous[0] !== current[0] || previous[2] !== current[2] || (previous[1] !== null && current[1] !== null && current[1] < previous[1]))) errors.push("attempt-progress-is-monotonic");
      progress.set(id, current);
    }
    if (event.interruptionKind === "security-lock") securityLocked = true;
    else if (securityLocked && kind === "workflow-run" && ["running", "succeeded"].includes(event.toState as string)) errors.push("security-lock-does-not-auto-resume");
  });
  if (snapshot.sequence !== (snapshot.history as unknown[]).length) errors.push("history-sequence-is-contiguous");
  return { state, latest, errors };
};

export const workflowSnapshotErrors = (definitionValue: unknown, value: unknown): readonly string[] => {
  if (workflowDefinitionErrors(definitionValue).length > 0) return ["workflow-snapshot-definition-invalid"];
  const structural = validationErrors(value, schemaDefinition("WorkflowSnapshot"), "$");
  if (structural.length > 0) return structural;
  const definition = definitionValue as Record<string, unknown>;
  const snapshot = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const reference = snapshot.definition as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (reference.workflowDefinitionId !== definition.workflowDefinitionId || reference.definitionRevisionId !== definition.definitionRevisionId || reference.definitionVersion !== definition.definitionVersion || reference.contentHash !== workflowRecordSha256(definition)) errors.push("snapshot-binds-exact-definition");
  if (progressInvalid(snapshot.progress as Record<string, unknown>) || ["stepRuns", "attempts"].some((collection) => (snapshot[collection] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).some((item) => progressInvalid(item.progress as Record<string, unknown>)))) errors.push("progress-shape-is-consistent");
  const cancellation = snapshot.cancellation as Record<string, unknown>;
  if ((cancellation.requestedAt === null) !== (cancellation.reasonCode === null) || (cancellation.requestedAt === null) !== (cancellation.interruptionKind === null)) errors.push("cancellation-shape-is-consistent");
  const stepRuns = collectionMap(snapshot, "stepRuns", "stepRunId");
  const jobs = collectionMap(snapshot, "jobs", "jobId");
  const attempts = collectionMap(snapshot, "attempts", "attemptId");
  const checkpoints = collectionMap(snapshot, "checkpoints", "checkpointId");
  const artifacts = collectionMap(snapshot, "artifacts", "artifactId");
  const humanTasks = collectionMap(snapshot, "humanTasks", "humanTaskId");
  if ([stepRuns.size !== (snapshot.stepRuns as unknown[]).length, jobs.size !== (snapshot.jobs as unknown[]).length, attempts.size !== (snapshot.attempts as unknown[]).length, checkpoints.size !== (snapshot.checkpoints as unknown[]).length, artifacts.size !== (snapshot.artifacts as unknown[]).length, humanTasks.size !== (snapshot.humanTasks as unknown[]).length].some(Boolean)) errors.push("identities-are-unique");
  const definitionSteps = new Map((definition.steps as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).map((step) => [step.stepKey as string, step]));
  const stepKeys = new Set([...stepRuns.values()].map((step) => step.stepKey as string));
  if (stepKeys.size !== definitionSteps.size || [...definitionSteps.keys()].some((key) => !stepKeys.has(key))) errors.push("references-close-over-snapshot");
  for (const step of stepRuns.values()) {
    if ((step.jobIds as string[]).some((id) => jobs.get(id)?.stepRunId !== step.stepRunId) || (step.humanTaskIds as string[]).some((id) => humanTasks.get(id)?.stepRunId !== step.stepRunId) || [...(step.inputArtifactIds as string[]), ...(step.outputArtifactIds as string[])].some((id) => !artifacts.has(id))) errors.push("references-close-over-snapshot");
    const defined = definitionSteps.get(step.stepKey as string);
    if (defined !== undefined && ((defined.kind === "human-task") !== ((step.humanTaskIds as string[]).length > 0))) errors.push("step-shape-matches-kind");
  }
  const idempotency = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const job of jobs.values()) {
    if (!stepRuns.has(job.stepRunId as string) || !(stepRuns.get(job.stepRunId as string)?.jobIds as string[]).includes(job.jobId as string) || (job.attemptIds as string[]).some((id) => attempts.get(id)?.jobId !== job.jobId) || (job.currentAttemptId !== null && !(job.attemptIds as string[]).includes(job.currentAttemptId as string)) || [...(job.inputArtifactIds as string[]), ...(job.outputArtifactIds as string[])].some((id) => !artifacts.has(id))) errors.push("references-close-over-snapshot");
    const prior = idempotency.get(job.idempotencyKey as string);
    if (prior !== undefined && prior !== job.commandFingerprint) errors.push("job-idempotency-binds-command-fingerprint");
    idempotency.set(job.idempotencyKey as string, job.commandFingerprint as string);
    const jobAttempts: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    for (const id of job.attemptIds as string[]) {
      const attempt = attempts.get(id);
      if (attempt !== undefined) jobAttempts.push(attempt);
    }
    const numbers = jobAttempts.map((item) => item.attemptNumber as number).sort((a,b) => a-b);
    if (!numbers.every((number, index) => number === index + 1)) errors.push("attempt-numbers-are-contiguous");
    const succeeded = jobAttempts.filter((item) => item.state === "succeeded");
    if (succeeded.length > 1) errors.push("job-has-at-most-one-succeeded-attempt");
    const succeededAttempt = succeeded[0];
    if (job.state === "succeeded" && (succeeded.length !== 1 || succeededAttempt === undefined || job.currentAttemptId !== succeededAttempt.attemptId || stableJson(job.outputArtifactIds) !== stableJson(succeededAttempt.outputArtifactIds) || (job.outputArtifactIds as string[]).some((id) => artifacts.get(id)?.disposition !== "committed"))) errors.push("succeeded-output-artifacts-are-committed");
  }
  for (const attempt of attempts.values()) {
    if (!jobs.has(attempt.jobId as string) || !(jobs.get(attempt.jobId as string)?.attemptIds as string[]).includes(attempt.attemptId as string)) errors.push("references-close-over-snapshot");
    if ((attempt.checkpointIds as string[]).some((id) => checkpoints.get(id)?.attemptId !== attempt.attemptId)) errors.push("checkpoint-order-and-owner-are-consistent");
    if ((attempt.outputArtifactIds as string[]).some((id) => artifacts.get(id)?.createdByAttemptId !== attempt.attemptId)) errors.push("references-close-over-snapshot");
    if (attempt.state !== "succeeded" && (attempt.outputArtifactIds as string[]).length > 0) errors.push("unsuccessful-attempt-has-no-accepted-output");
  }
  const checkpointsByAttempt = new Map<string, Array<Record<string, unknown>>>();
  for (const checkpoint of checkpoints.values()) {
    const attemptCheckpoints = checkpointsByAttempt.get(checkpoint.attemptId as string) ?? [];
    attemptCheckpoints.push(checkpoint);
    checkpointsByAttempt.set(checkpoint.attemptId as string, attemptCheckpoints);
    const payload = artifacts.get(checkpoint.payloadArtifactId as string);
    const event = (snapshot.history as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).find((item) => item.sequence === checkpoint.historySequence);
    if (!attempts.has(checkpoint.attemptId as string) || payload?.role !== "checkpoint" || payload.createdByAttemptId !== checkpoint.attemptId || event?.entityType !== "job-attempt" || event.entityId !== checkpoint.attemptId || event.checkpointId !== checkpoint.checkpointId) errors.push("checkpoint-order-and-owner-are-consistent");
  }
  for (const attemptCheckpoints of checkpointsByAttempt.values()) {
    const ordered = [...attemptCheckpoints].sort((left, right) => (left.checkpointSequence as number) - (right.checkpointSequence as number));
    if (!ordered.every((checkpoint, index) => checkpoint.checkpointSequence === index + 1) || ordered.some((checkpoint, index) => index > 0 && (ordered[index - 1]?.historySequence as number) >= (checkpoint.historySequence as number))) errors.push("checkpoint-order-and-owner-are-consistent");
  }
  for (const artifact of artifacts.values()) {
    if (artifact.createdByAttemptId !== null && !attempts.has(artifact.createdByAttemptId as string)) errors.push("references-close-over-snapshot");
  }
  const rebuilt = reconstruct(snapshot);
  errors.push(...rebuilt.errors);
  if (rebuilt.state["workflow-run"][snapshot.workflowRunId as string] !== snapshot.state) errors.push("history-reconstructs-current-state");
  for (const [kind, collection, idKey] of [["workflow-step", "stepRuns", "stepRunId"], ["job", "jobs", "jobId"], ["job-attempt", "attempts", "attemptId"], ["human-task", "humanTasks", "humanTaskId"]] as const) {
    for (const item of snapshot[collection] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) {
      const id = item[idKey] as string;
      if (rebuilt.state[kind][id] !== item.state || rebuilt.latest.get(`${kind}:${id}`) !== item.sequence) errors.push("history-reconstructs-current-state");
    }
  }
  for (const task of humanTasks.values()) {
    const step = stepRuns.get(task.stepRunId as string);
    const defined = step === undefined ? undefined : definitionSteps.get(step.stepKey as string);
    if (task.workflowRunId !== snapshot.workflowRunId || task.definitionRevisionId !== definition.definitionRevisionId || step === undefined || !(step.humanTaskIds as string[]).includes(task.humanTaskId as string) || defined?.kind !== "human-task" || task.requiredRole !== (defined.humanTask as Record<string, unknown>).requiredRole || (task.evidenceArtifactIds as string[]).some((id) => !artifacts.has(id))) errors.push("references-close-over-snapshot");
    const decision = asRecord(task.decision);
    if ((task.state === "completed") !== (decision !== null)) errors.push("completed-human-task-binds-decision");
    if (decision !== null) {
      const completion = (snapshot.history as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).filter((event) => event.entityType === "human-task" && event.entityId === task.humanTaskId && event.toState === "completed");
      const actor = completion.length === 1 ? asRecord(completion[0]?.actor) : null;
      if (completion.length !== 1 || completion[0]?.decisionId !== decision.decisionId || stableJson(actor) !== stableJson(decision.decidedBy) || stableJson(task.assignedTo) !== stableJson(decision.decidedBy) || (decision.decidedBy as Record<string, unknown>).actorType !== "human" || (decision.decidedBy as Record<string, unknown>).role !== task.requiredRole || decision.decidedAt !== completion[0]?.occurredAt || (decision.evidenceArtifactIds as string[]).some((id) => !artifacts.has(id)) || (decision.rationaleArtifactId !== null && !artifacts.has(decision.rationaleArtifactId as string))) errors.push("human-decision-is-audit-bound");
    }
  }
  if (cancellation.interruptionKind === "security-lock" && !["cancelling", "cancelled", "failed"].includes(snapshot.state as string)) errors.push("security-lock-does-not-auto-resume");
  return [...new Set(errors)];
};

export const decodeWorkflowSnapshot = (definition: unknown, value: unknown): WorkflowSnapshot | null => {
  let owned: unknown;
  try { owned = ownedFrozen(value); } catch { return null; }
  return workflowSnapshotErrors(definition, owned).length === 0 ? (owned as WorkflowSnapshot) : null;
};

export const reconstructWorkflowState = (definition: unknown, value: unknown): ReconstructedWorkflowState | null => {
  if (workflowSnapshotErrors(definition, value).length > 0) return null;
  const { state } = reconstruct(value as Record<string, unknown>);
  return ownedFrozen(state) as ReconstructedWorkflowState;
};

export const legacyOperationBridgeErrors = (snapshotValue: unknown, value: unknown): readonly string[] => {
  const structural = validationErrors(value, schemaDefinition("LegacyOperationBridge"), "$");
  if (structural.length > 0) return structural;
  const snapshot = asRecord(snapshotValue);
  const bridge = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (snapshot === null || snapshot.documentType !== "research-observatory-workflow-snapshot") return ["legacy-operation-bridge-snapshot-invalid"];
  const mapped: Record<string, string> = {accepted:"queued",running:"running","waiting-human":"running",paused:"running",cancelling:"running",succeeded:"succeeded",failed:"failed",cancelled:"cancelled"};
  const cancellation = snapshot.cancellation as Record<string, unknown>;
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (bridge.workflowRunId !== snapshot.workflowRunId || bridge.workflowSnapshotRevision !== snapshot.snapshotRevision || bridge.operationState !== mapped[snapshot.state as string] || bridge.cancellationRequested !== (cancellation.requestedAt !== null)) errors.push("legacy-operation-bridge-binds-exact-workflow-projection");
  if (bridge.etag !== `"${bridge.legacyOperationId as string}-${bridge.operationSequence as number}"`) errors.push("legacy-operation-bridge-etag-is-exact");
  return errors;
};

export const decodeLegacyOperationBridge = (snapshot: unknown, value: unknown): LegacyOperationBridge | null => {
  let owned: unknown;
  try { owned = ownedFrozen(value); } catch { return null; }
  return legacyOperationBridgeErrors(snapshot, owned).length === 0 ? (owned as LegacyOperationBridge) : null;
};
